source_documents.title: Non-Volatile Thermochromic Fluorescence Switching with Pressure Erasing in an Organic Crystal via Exciton Coupling Amplification

hidden_reference.publication_date_note: OpenAlex date; precedes the acceptance date printed in the PDF (2026-10-05), to be checked

reference_evidence_units.quote: Relative to the monomer, the O‑form crystal shows a significant red shift in both absorption (to 447 nm) and emission (to 595 nm), consistent with stronger intermolecular interactions in the aggregated state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3D2Et
reference_evidence_units.conditions: toluene solution vs O-form and G-form crystals
reference_evidence_units.statement: O-form is red-shifted from the monomer; G-form is close to the monomer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: As shown in Figure 3c, the exciton coupling energy of the O‑form is 41 meV, significantly higher than that of the G‑form (21 meV).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3D2Et dimers from the two crystal structures
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated exciton coupling 41 meV (O-form) vs 21 meV (G-form).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Dimer model from crystal geometry; one functional.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Notably, the distance between adjacent molecules in intra-dimer expands from 3.96 Å in the O‑form to 7.22 Å in the G‑form
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3D2Et
reference_evidence_units.statement: Intradimer distance grows and molecules twist more in the G-form.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Crystal structures; the thermally converted powder is matched by PXRD.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This indicates that conformational change alone cannot account for the observed optical response
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3D2Et
reference_evidence_units.statement: Conformational energy difference (0.09 eV) is much smaller than the 0.29 eV spectral shift.

reference_evidence_units.quote: confirming that the emission from both crystals is fluorescence
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3D2Et O-form and G-form
reference_evidence_units.statement: Single-exponential ns decays at 298 and 77 K: the emission is fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Does not exclude dark triplet channels.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This decrease in exciton coupling energy triggers a cascade of photophysical effects, including redistribution of oscillator strength and modulation of the excited‑state potential energy surface
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3D2Et
reference_evidence_units.statement: Weaker coupling redistributes oscillator strength, which the authors link to the quantum-yield rise (0.17 to 0.40).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No measured or computed radiative rates are reported.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Thermochromism attributed to reduced intermolecular exciton coupling after the O-to-G phase transition.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Quantum-yield change explained through oscillator-strength redistribution, as a consequence of the exciton-coupling change.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Dihedral angles change between polymorphs, but no restricted motion is invoked; conformational change alone is said not to explain the shift.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Donor-acceptor structure, but the paper does not discuss charge transfer.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No intramolecular proton donor-acceptor pair (no OH/NH next to an acceptor).

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Thermochromism attributed to reduced intermolecular exciton coupling after the O-to-G phase transition.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Quantum-yield change explained through oscillator-strength redistribution, as a consequence of the exciton-coupling change.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Emission of both crystal forms is shown to be fluorescence (single-exponential ns decay at 298 and 77 K).

environment_context.effect: heat-written, pressure-erased polymorph change alters dimer packing
